title: Let your word be born

lines.text: Let Your Word be born in the manger of my heart,
Let it live in me, let it shine,
Live inside this house of clay,
Let Your Word be born in the manger of my heart.

chords:
[Verse]
[D]Let Your Word be born in the [G]manger of my [D]heart,
[D]Let it live in me, let it [A]shine,
[D]Live inside this [D7]house of clay,
[G]And mould me every [D]day,
Let Your Word be [A]born in the manger of my [D]heart.
lyrics:
[Verse]
Let Your Word be born in the manger of my heart,
Let it live in me, let it shine,
Live inside this house of clay,
And mould me every day,
Let Your Word be born in the manger of my heart.
